# Seafin

> Seafin LLC (Oceanside, California) is an AI consulting firm for small and mid-sized US businesses (about 5 to 100 people) that have no AI team. Seafin finds where AI pays off, sets up Claude or ChatGPT for teams, builds custom AI workflows into the tools a business already uses, and keeps them running. A person approves the result wherever it matters. Clients own what is built for them.

## Services and prices
- Strategy Audit: $499, about one week. A 2-hour working session, a written report with the top three AI opportunities, estimated savings and a 90-day plan, then a 1-hour walkthrough. Money back if it can't find at least $499 a year in savings; the fee comes off a build started within 60 days.
- Set up Claude or ChatGPT for your team: $1,500 for up to 10 people, about a week, done remotely.
- Custom Builds: fixed price agreed after the audit, typically 2 to 6 weeks.
- Managed AI: month to month.

## What Seafin builds
Phone agents that book jobs; invoice and contract audits that find overcharges; AI that uses websites and portals with no other way in; turning photos and paper into data; overnight work with a spending cap; replacing outgrown software; websites with AI built in; documents into accounting systems and CRMs.

## Where it runs
Directly through Anthropic (Claude) or OpenAI business accounts, or inside the client's own Amazon, Microsoft or Google cloud account for compliance needs such as HIPAA.
